correctness.rationale: Sign reversal of a (t,t,1−2t) law reverses p_t(z), leaving four candidates up to global reflection. Log-concavity of each support convolution localizes modes, and the source exact ordered-simplex barycentric substitution gives eight homogeneous cubic modal comparisons with 20 coefficients apiece, all nonnegative. I independently reconstructed all 160 integer coefficients using separate JS polynomial convolution of the actual ordered vertices; all exactly matched COEFFICIENTS.tsv with minimum 0. Five coefficient factorizations dominate two mixed patterns, leaving A=ab+ac+bc−3abc and B=7abc−4ab−ac−bc+a+b, with A−B=(1−2c)(5ab−a−b). Strictly ordered interior cases have unique optimal sign up to global reversal, ties at equality, and endpoints follow weak inequalities; rational examples corroborate but do not prove continuum theorem.
